facts.fact: The national cybercrime unit sentenced journalist Chahana Takiou, founder-publisher of 22 septembre, to 12 months in prison with 6 suspended for undermining the State's credit through the judicial institution, after he said at the Pan-African Media Forum in June 2026 that journalists should be tried under the press-offence law rather than the cybercrime law.
